## Summary

An indie life sim, in early access since May 2026, in which players build grid-less homes and guide Parafolks with needs, emotions, traits, skills, and careers in an open-world town.

## Core Loop

design Parafolks in the Paramaker -> build a grid-less home -> Parafolks pursue needs and wants -> socialize, work, and build skills around town -> relationships, children, and aging change the household -> share homes and Parafolks on the Workshop

## Design Notes

Paralives began as Alex Massé's solo project, was funded through Patreon (over 15,000 supporters by November 2023), and entered Steam early access on 2026-05-25 with about two years planned before 1.0. Its building tools are its most distinctive system: walls and furniture resize, recolor, and stack, walls can curve, floors can split level, and a road-style wall tool was inspired by Cities: Skylines. Conversation fills a together bar that unlocks together cards, multiselect lets several Parafolks act as a group, and procedural animation adapts to preceding animations.

- [Building placement](../mechanic/free-placement.md) (core): Grid-less building with curved walls, split-level floors, and resizable, recolorable, stackable furniture; walls are drawn with a road-style tool modeled on Cities: Skylines.
- [Needs decay](../mechanic/needs-decay.md) (core): Parafolks carry needs, wants, and emotions that steer their autonomous behavior and set the player's care tasks.
- [Personality traits](../mechanic/personality-traits.md) (supporting)
- [Agent skills](../mechanic/agent-skills.md) (supporting)
- [Relationship values](../mechanic/relationship-values.md) (supporting): Conversation fills a together bar between two Parafolks, and a full bar unlocks together cards.
- [Romance and family](../mechanic/romance-family.md) (supporting)
- [Career ladder](../mechanic/career-ladder.md) (supporting): Jobs with flexible career progression paths.
- [Lifecycle and aging](../mechanic/lifecycle-aging.md) (supporting)
- [Content sharing](../mechanic/content-sharing.md) (supporting): Steam Workshop distributes community houses, Parafolks, and mods.
- [Modding API](../mechanic/modding-api.md) (supporting): An in-game modding interface lets players edit or add content.
